props.title: Page not found
props.description: A moved page or a mistyped address. Every page on the site is one click away.

props.html:
404

This page ends earlier than our sets do.

The link may be old, or the address mistyped. Everything on the site is one click away below.

  • Corporate: company parties, galas, client dinners and retreats
  • Weddings: the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the floor
  • Private Parties: at home, in a yard, or in a space you booked
  • Daytime: senior living, memorials, brunch and community programs
  • Artist Roster: the acts and every configuration
  • Songs: the whole song book
  • Pricing: what live music costs in this market
  • For Planners: how we work with professionals
  • All pages: every page on the site, in one list
Back to the start Check a Date
props._notes:
The page's playful line is the headline itself, so the .smile
           italic rides the h2 size (§6.4).

Rebuilt 2026-09-22. It had offered five links, two of them under names
         the site stopped using: "The Music" (the roster is Artist Roster in
         the nav row and the footer) and "Corporate & Galas" (retired in the
         17 Aug audit, when galas became a section of the corporate hub rather
         than a co-headline). It also offered no way into Weddings, Private
         Parties or Daytime — three of the four occasion trees. It now carries
         what the footer carries, in the same words, plus the full index.
         Labels match the nav row character for character; scripts/nav_lint.py
         reads this list along with the header and the footer.
